name: ictrp_search
description: Search the WHO International Clinical Trials Registry Platform — one search across ClinicalTrials.gov and the WHO primary registries (ChiCTR China, jRCT/JPRN Japan, CTRI India, IRCT Iran, DRKS Germany, ANZCTR, ISRCTN, EU CTR/CTIS, CRIS Korea, ReBec Brazil, PACTR, TCTR and more). The way to find Chinese, Japanese, Indian and Iranian trials that ClinicalTrials.gov does not carry. Give a free-text query (searches titles, conditions and interventions, with WHO synonym expansion) and/or condition / intervention / sponsor fields; filter by source registry or recruiting status. Each row carries the trial id, its source registry, recruitment status, registration date and the ICTRP record URL — call ictrp_trial for the full record.

query.description: Free text, e.g. "psilocybin" or "psilocybin depression". With condition/intervention/sponsor it is matched against the trial TITLE only.

registry.description: Keep only trials from one source registry: CT.gov, ANZCTR, ChiCTR, ITMCTR, CTRI, IRCT, DRKS, jRCT, JPRN, ISRCTN, EU-CTR, CTIS, CRIS, TCTR, PACTR, ReBec, LBCTR, NL-OMON, REPEC, SLCTR, RPCEC. Matched on the trial-id prefix.

recruiting_only.description: Only trials whose status is Recruiting.

name: ictrp_trial
description: The WHO Trial Registration Data Set for one trial from any registry the WHO ICTRP covers, by its registry id (e.g. "ChiCTR2400080001", "CTRI/2024/01/061234", "IRCT20230101056789N1", "DRKS00031234", "jRCT2031230001", "NCT06123456", "ACTRN12626001215314"): source registry and its record URL, titles, primary sponsor, recruitment status, study type and design, phase, countries of recruitment, conditions, interventions, primary and secondary outcomes, eligibility (criteria, age range, sex), target sample size, dates, funding sources, secondary ids, ethics review status. Contact-person details are not returned.

trial_id.description: Registry trial id as the source registry writes it, e.g. "ChiCTR2400080001".
